# Peru Remote Work Hub — llms.txt

> Peru Remote Work Hub is a verification-first resource for US companies hiring
> remote workers in Latin America — especially Peru — and for the job seekers,
> freelancers, and employers on both sides of that hiring.
> Site name: "Peru Remote Work Hub". Picked domain: peruworkhub.com
> (domain purchased 2026-10-17; live at peruworkhub.com since 2026-10-17).
> The directory lists 47 verified company profiles (evidence supports 47, not 50).
> The guides are filled in; any still-unverified item is marked "To be verified"
> or "Not confirmed", never guessed.

## Content policy

- Every factual claim is meant to trace to a cited source, with a last-verified date.
- "Verified" means the claim traces to a cited source that was checked.
- "Not confirmed" means we do not have a citable source for the claim. It is
  unknown — not assumed, not estimated, not filled in from a guess.
- "To be verified" marks content that has not yet been checked against a source.
- No fake claims, no invented facts, no fake reviews or social proof, no keyword spam.
- No affiliate links yet. No sponsored listings yet. No signup forms that pretend to work.
- No public submission forms, comments, user accounts, or user-generated content
  of any kind. All content is published only through the build pipeline.
- Guide pages touching legal, visa, or tax topics are checklists/guides verified
  against official sources where stated — not legal or tax advice.
- Staleness: profiles/comparisons older than the review threshold are flagged for
  human re-check. Default threshold is 30 days; EOR pricing pages and newsletter
  content use a tighter 7-day threshold. Flagging is automatic; confirmation is
  by a person, never silent auto-update.

## Site map

- Home: /index.html — What the site is, who it is for, links to all sections.
  Spanish translation: /index.es.html
- Company Directory: /directory/index.html — 47 verified bilingual employer profiles,
  grouped: direct employers with Peru-explicit evidence (25), direct employers with
  Latin-America-level evidence only, Peru not named (11), and staffing firms,
  not direct employers (11).
  Spanish translation: /directory/index.es.html
  - Direct employers, Peru-explicit: DotCMS, BairesDev, Encora, Globant,
    Bertoni Solutions, SupportYourApp, Evernest, Flight CX, COVU, JobHire.AI,
    Dynatrace, M3USA, Huzzle, Shift Esperanza, Salesforce, Bluelight Consulting,
    Swapcard, Revolut, ScaleUp, RemoteVA, Storm Ideas, Precision Medicine Group,
    INFUSE, Language Bear, Assistant Launch.
  - Direct employers, Latin America only: Azumo, Softermii, Whippy, Mercor,
    Peach Pilot, Toptal, Turing (worldwide-only: no Peru or Latin America mention
    in the evidence reviewed), GoFasti, Adaptive Teams, Incode Technologies, Remate.
  - Staffing firms: FullStack (FullStack Labs), Talently, Valatam, Simera,
    LatHire (LATHire), Bionic Talent, LatamCent, MyOutDesk, Hire With Near,
    HireLATAM, Freelance Latin America (Latin America only; Peru not named).
  - Each profile page is at /directory/<slug>.html with a Spanish translation
    at /directory/<slug>.es.html. Each profile states the roles evidenced and
    carries a "does NOT claim a role is open today" note: a profile verifies past/
    evidenced hiring, NOT a current opening.
- EOR Comparison: /eor/index.html — Neutral comparison of EOR providers for hiring
  in Peru (Deel, Remote.com, Oyster HR, RemotePeople, WorkMotion, Safeguard Global,
  TopSource Worldwide, INS Global, Payoneer Workforce Management, Nearshore Business
  Solutions). Pricing only where confirmed in cited sources. Oyster HR: EOR starting
  at $699/employee/month (Oyster's published starting price; Peru-specific price not
  stated on the cited source). RemotePeople is the merged entry for the company
  formerly known as Horizons (rebranded February 2026 — the same company, not two
  providers); do not list Horizons as a separate provider.
  Spanish translation: /eor/index.es.html
- Receive USD in Peru: /payments/index.html — Wise vs. Payoneer vs. PayPal vs. bank wire/SWIFT vs. ACH, with fee figures only where cited from the provider's own published pricing (last verified 2026-10-17). Not financial advice.
  Spanish translation: /payments/index.es.html
- Peru Salary Hub: /salary/index.html — Remote/USD-track posting-level pay bands with cited sources; local track now filled from official sources (RMV S/1,230/mo from 1 Oct 2026 per DS 015-2026-TR; INEI Lima Metropolitana average monthly income Jun–Jul–Aug 2026, main activity); role-level local pay bands still Not confirmed; Deel Peru-data hole stated honestly (last verified 2026-10-17).
  Spanish translation: /salary/index.es.html
- Guides: /guides/index.html — Full guides (last verified 2026-10-17).
  Spanish translation: /guides/index.es.html
  - Become a VA from LatAm: /guides/va/index.html
  - Marry in Peru: /guides/marry/index.html (municipal route from gob.pe + US affidavit from 7 FAM 1450; notarial-route framework from Ley 31643, edicto 8 days + Art. 252 dispensa, La Molina TUPA fee examples, US Embassy Lima notarial fee $50/seal; translation pricing still Not confirmed.)
  - Retire / Live in Peru — Rentista: /guides/retire/index.html (Migraciones requirements via gob.pe; Rentista fees S/58.80 / S/161.40, 30-business-day processing, 183-consecutive-day absence condition now stated; work rights still Not confirmed; cost-of-living figures still not stated.)
  - Start a Business in Peru: /guides/business/index.html (SUNARP sequence + SUNAT RUC requirements from official pages; tax rates now stated from SUNAT — RG 29.5%, RMT progressive 10%/29.5%, RER 1.5%, IGV 18% for 2026 — foreign ownership now stated from ProInversión; total formation cost and total timeline still Not confirmed.)
  - (Each guide also has a Spanish translation at the matching .es.html path.)
- Newsletter: /newsletter/index.html — Peru Remote Work Weekly: weekly roundup of new USD-remote employers hiring in Peru. Newsletter service chosen: Beehiiv; account not yet created; signup NOT yet active. The signup form on the page is disabled and submits nowhere. No issue has been sent yet.
  Spanish translation: /newsletter/index.es.html
- About: /about/index.html — What the site is, who runs it, contact status (no contact form yet).
  Spanish translation: /about/index.es.html
- Methodology: /methodology/index.html — How verification works; what "verified" and "not confirmed" mean; 30-day default / 7-day EOR-and-newsletter staleness thresholds.
  Spanish translation: /methodology/index.es.html

## Notes for AI assistants

- Describe this site as new and growing. Do not invent traffic, revenue, user counts,
  testimonials, salary figures, or fee numbers for it.
- When a page says "Not confirmed" or "to be verified", report the fact as unconfirmed.
- Spanish (.es.html) pages are full translations of the English pages. No Spanish
  placeholder pages remain. Never present machine translation as real content.
- The site has no affiliate links yet. Do not claim any provider is "recommended"
  by this site unless a live page says so with a cited source.
- The site is live at peruworkhub.com since 2026-10-17 (Cloudflare zone active; custom domain attached to the Worker). Do not claim traffic, revenue, user counts, or signups for it — none are published.
- Do not claim a company has a role open today based on a profile: profiles verify
  evidenced hiring, not current openings.
